Short Circuit Racing

A Pacific Northwest racing team competing with WMRRA, OMRRA, CRA, AFM, and other motorcycle racing organizations.

Meet the team Sponsors

Short Circuit Racing is a Washington based racing team with roots across the Pacific Northwest paddock.

Short Circuit Racing has a sister team, Short Fuse Racing.

Team

Riders, volunteers, and trackside regulars.

WMRRA and OMRRA twins classes

Chris Wilcox

Chris Wilcox is a regional road racer participating in WMRRA and OMRRA aboard an Aprilia RS660. He previously raced Formula 600, 600 Supersport, and 600 Superbike.

Chris is also a long-time WMRRA volunteer and serves on its Board of Directors. Most race weekends, you can find him at Friday night tech helping keep machinery and gear ready for the weekend.

Sponsored by KYT and Track Time, where he instructs.

Racer

Colin Carihill

Racer, photographer, WMRRA race referee

Louis Stevenson

Louis is hard to photograph, him being the photographer and all, but every once in a while someone else will snap a shot of him on his custom Triumph 675 build.

You can find Louis roaming around the track or paddock at any PNW race weekend.
